result.title: Design Space Exploration of Reinforcement Learning Configurations for Post-Legalization Placement
result.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) have recently been explored for VLSI placement optimization, but their effectiveness for post-legalization placement refinement remains unclear. This paper presents a systematic design space exploration of a GNN-Proximal Policy Optimization (GNN-PPO) framework across three ISPD2015 benchmarks. We evaluate 18 configurations covering reward functions, GNN architectures, action spaces, candidate-set sizes, and training strategies. We analyse the results we obtain to identify pitfalls and to assess the prospects and opportunities of the RL methods for post-legalization placement. On top of that we propose a design classification approach to guide the design decisions of RL models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在三个 ISPD2015 基准上系统探索 GNN-PPO 框架用于 legalization 后布局精修的设计空间，比较 18 种配置（奖励函数、GNN 结构、动作空间、候选集大小、训练策略），分析其陷阱并给出一套设计分类方法来指导 RL 模型的设计决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 EDA 布局这一较远领域，但其对 RL 动作空间、候选集规模与训练策略的系统消融与陷阱总结，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 动作空间设定、候选视觉证据筛选与训练配置选择提供可核查的方法模板。
